Definition: Jarib, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jarib = "he contends"; 1) a son of Simeon; 2) one of the chief men of Israel who returned from exile with Ezra; 3) son of Jozadak and a priest of the house of Jeshua who married a foreign wife and was compelled by Ezra to put her away
